findingDetails.title: the hook's advisor CLI child receives the full user prompt in its process arguments
findingDetails.description: runCliRecommend passes payload.prompt through the spawn argv (--json JSON.stringify(payload)); argv is readable by other local users and by crash/audit tooling. The subsystem's other path already uses stdin (runtime/lib/subprocess.ts:204).
findingDetails.impact: Prompt content (code, paths, possible secrets) is transiently exposed to local observers on every hook turn.
findingDetails.recommendation: Carry the prompt over stdin in runCliRecommend as subprocess.ts does, or pass the payload via env/pipe.

findingDetails.title: shim nested deadline holds only when SPECKIT_CLAUDE_HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS is unset
findingDetails.description: The child advisor budget is seeded below the 2500ms kill deadline only when the env is unset; an operator value >= the kill window reintroduces the dropped-fallback failure phase 2 fixes.
findingDetails.impact: Slow advisor turns deliver {} instead of the fallback directive under a plausible override.
findingDetails.recommendation: Clamp the child budget to min(env, CHILD_TIMEOUT_MS - CHILD_START_MARGIN_MS).
